name: matewishkey
description: Shortcuts from Mate Wish Key, for people who have never opened a terminal.

plugins.name: mwk-genie
plugins.description: Start a project, and save one. Two commands for people who are not developers: /mwk-genie:new-project makes a folder in ~/projects with save points and a private GitHub repo, and /mwk-genie:save writes down what changed, pushes it, and leaves a note for next time.
